left.tested_scope: Executable reference crash-consistency state machine with durable attempt/cell intents, stable content-bound cell IDs, reconcile-before-execute, immutable local outcomes and deterministic certification. The controller was actually SIGKILLed at six exact boundaries from post-intent/pre-dispatch through post-terminal-seal. Across all six recoveries the three-cell provider simulator produced exactly three execute effects, the remote-effect/local-outcome crash reconciled rather than re-executed, the certificate digest was identical, and a second fresh-process certify caused zero additional provider execute/reconcile calls. Scope is limited to a deterministic SQLite-backed provider model whose stable cell ID is an authoritative idempotency key; arbitrary real providers require equivalent durable idempotency or reconciliation, otherwise ambiguity must fail closed as UNKNOWN.

right.tested_scope: Independent source-derived CAUSE formula/timing sanity reimplementation, explicitly not author code and not an exact reproduction claim. It implemented the published Eq.29 decision timing plus cited S/D/alpha* equations and ran a fixed-seed 3000-run Monte Carlo check. Rested s={9,25} realized discounted regret was 23.0939±0.4348 versus published 22.61±0.88; rested s={9,900} was 41.5765±1.3673 versus published 42.71±2.40. The source artifact interprets both rested checks as within combined Monte Carlo uncertainty of the published means and records main restless values only as local controls because exact Figure 1 numerical labels were not source-recovered. This scope is algorithmic/formula reproducibility evidence under the stated Gaussian-state-space bandit setup, not crash-consistency, idempotency, recovery, or provider-effect evidence.
